description: Save a new email as a DRAFT in YOUR Outlook Drafts folder. Never sends: you review and send it from Outlook. Previews first; saves only on a second call with confirm: true and the preview_id. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: true only on the second call, after the person agreed to the preview.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key on a retry replays instead of saving twice.

preview_id.description: preview_id from the preview call. Required with confirm: true.

name: draft_outlook_email
title: Draft an Outlook email
